caption: 원래 함수 f(x)=x⁴−8x²+5의 닫힌 정의구간 [−3,1]은 그대로 두고, 도식에는 정확한 평행이동 u(x)=f(x)+11=(x²−4)²만 그린다. A(−3,25), B(−2,0), C(0,16), D(1,9)는 각각 원래 f값 14, −11, 5, −2에 대응한다. 원래 f의 최댓값은 14, 최솟값은 −11이므로 그 합은 3이다.

sourceConditions.condition: 원문 f(x)=x⁴−8x²+5 on the closed interval [−3,1]. The plotted curve is the exact vertical shift u(x)=f(x)+11=(x²−4)²; the x-domain is unchanged.
f′(x)=4x(x−2)(x+2); the critical points in [−3,1] are −2 and 0. Original endpoint/critical values are f(−3)=14, f(−2)=−11, f(0)=5, f(1)=−2; shifted u-values are 25,0,16,9.
The source function has max 14 and min −11 on [−3,1], so their sum is 3. The figure is u, never labelled as original f.

newVisualInformation: The exact vertical shift keeps the full source interval and maps each endpoint/critical point back to the original f-values. The axis and function name explicitly say u, not f.
